title: The Interactive Red Furniture Mind Hack

vo.en: I'll read your mind right now.

visual.description: A extreme macro shot of a man's eye with digital data reflections in the iris.

vo.en: Quick, pick a number between one and ten. Multiply it by two. Now add eight.

visual.description: Golden 3D numbers spinning and flying towards the camera in a dark void.

vo.en: Divide the total by two. Subtract your original number. You’re left with four, right?

visual.description: A man’s hand writing complex mathematical equations on a transparent glass pane.

vo.en: That was just math. This next part is where it gets truly creepy.

visual.description: Heavy digital static and television distortion effects flickering rapidly.

vo.en: Stare at the center and clear your head. Think of any color and a piece of furniture.

visual.description: Abstract geometric shapes morphing and pulsing in a hypnotic kaleidoscopic pattern.

vo.en: You're picturing a red chair. I just used semantic priming to hijack your brain.

visual.description: A single, minimalist red designer chair rotating slowly in a pure white studio space.

vo.en: Your mind is easier to hack than you think. Did I get it right?

visual.description: A digital model of a human brain with glowing blue neurons firing rapidly.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this worked, which is exactly why...

visual.description: Close up of a man's thumb scrolling through a smartphone social media feed.
